briefing: Markets sold off hard today with NASDAQ down 2.1% and S&P 500 down 1.1%, triggering a risk-off signal with no new candidates screened. Holding all 7 existing positions and keeping cash on the sidelines rather than forcing a buy into weakness.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' day is when investors broadly pull back from riskier assets like growth stocks, causing indices like NASDAQ to fall more than safer benchmarks. The right response is usually to hold existing positions and avoid forcing new trades until conditions improve, letting stop-losses and profit targets manage risk automatically.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「risk-off」(避險)日是指投資者普遍減持成長股等風險較高的資產,導致納斯達克等指數跌幅大於較穩健的指標。這種情況下,正確做法通常是持有現有倉位,避免勉強開新倉,讓停損和獲利點自動管理風險。

market_education.summary_en: Broad-based selling hit tech-heavy indices harder than the broader market today, with NASDAQ's 2.1% decline outpacing the S&P 500's 1.1% drop, consistent with a risk-off rotation away from growth and momentum names. No specific news headlines were provided for today's session, so this move appears driven by general risk sentiment rather than a single catalyst. In risk-off conditions like this, capital typically rotates toward defensive sectors and cash.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤出現全面性拋售,科技股為主的納斯達克指數下跌2.1%,跌幅超過標普500指數的1.1%,顯示市場正從成長股及強勢股中撤出資金,呈現避險情緒。由於今日未提供具體新聞標題,這次下跌看來是整體風險偏好轉弱所致,並非單一事件觸發。在這類risk-off環境下,資金通常會轉向防禦性板塊或現金。
